correctness.rationale: The exact finite formula telescopes the third finite difference and was cross-checked for each N=3..400. The two-root asymptotic follows from uniform binomial Edgeworth expansion, explicit Gaussian continuum moments, an Euler lattice correction for derivative jumps at 0 and ±sqrt(3), and parity-specific phase density. Coefficients were independently symbolically integrated and large-N sums checked. The uniformly bounded remainder follows from O(N^-2) integrated local error, O(h^3) cusp Euler remainder and O(N^-3/2) moving-root correction after scaling.

originality.rationale: The new object is the exact order-sqrt(N) lattice oscillation of a cubic Walsh projection constant, as opposed to the known leading asymptotic, general kernel formula, and the quadratic order-one phase law. Inspected close primary texts and the closest public database record, and compared equivalent Krawtchouk/binomial-absolute-moment formulations. value.rationale: Projection constants of homogeneous Boolean chaoses are natural Banach-space invariants; existing literature determined their leading growth, while a published degree-two result motivates studying fine lattice effects. The exact cubic three-cusp theorem establishes sharp limsup/inf, exhibits a genuine parity phase and a second oscillating root phase, and rules out any constant next-order coefficient. It is an all-dimensional structural asymptotic, not a numeric slice or routine renaming.
